The exhaustive 1024-subset certificate checks all edge signatures, domination predicates, and the entire S5 orbit partition of 4- and 5-sets; orbit representatives and sizes sum to 210 and 252. A separately constructed GP(5,2) graph with BFS distances independently reproduces every all-size coefficient. Scripts and actual outputs accompany the statement.

value.rationale: This answers a structurally natural first finite, highly symmetric non-bipartite test for a joint distance-based edge identification and coverage invariant. The absolute optimum 5 is one above its previously known ordinary edge-resolving value 4, while every ordinary optimum actively fails the coverage constraint; all 162 joint optima are classified geometrically into four different S5 orbits, and the all-size polynomials allow measurement of redundancy. Exact configuration data distinguish sensing tradeoffs and provide reproducible calibrating examples for broader graph-family research, rather than a trivial restatement of a known scalar.
